description: Which implementation-guide packages scripts/interop/fhir-validate.sh loads for each golden in conformance/golden/. The profile itself is NOT listed here: every instance declares its own in meta.profile, and the validator resolves it out of the packages named below. A golden with no packages is validated against base FHIR R4 only, which is weaker on purpose and recorded as such.

prior-authorization-eob.note: Declares the PDex Prior Authorization profile. This is the Patient Access prior-authorization payload CMS-0057-F asks for.

claim-eob.note: Base R4 only. The Provider Access payload is being reshaped onto the CARIN BB non-financial Basis ExplanationOfBenefit profiles; once it declares one, add hl7.fhir.us.carin-bb and the validator will judge it.

claim-as-billed.note: Base R4 only. A FHIR Claim is CHO-native source material, not a payload any CMS-0057-F profile governs, so there is no IG to load.

encounter.note: Base R4 only, for the same reason as claim-as-billed. Provider Access carries encounters inside a non-financial ExplanationOfBenefit, not as FHIR Encounter.
